builds.name: Kingslayer ceiling
builds.summary: Kingslayer max heal is 2*(100+.3 AP+.05 bonus HP) at <=40% HP. AP, heal power and Spirit Visage amplify self recovery; replace ally-only Staff.
builds.goal: Kingslayer max heal is 2*(100+.3 AP+.05 bonus HP) at <=40% HP. AP, heal power and Spirit Visage amplify self recovery; replace ally-only Staff.
builds.hypothesis:
Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing [75 / 110 / 145 / 180 / 215 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage. Against champions, Sylas restores between [20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 + (0.3) × AP + (0.05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] and [(20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 + (0.3) × AP + (0.05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]) × (2)] Health based on his missing Health (max healing at or below [40]% Health).
Deathcap supplies multiplicative AP; Dawncore converts the support items base mana regen into AP/heal power; Redemption/Mikael/Ardent/Staff supply heal power, with actives excluded. Aery/Revitalize favor eligible protection; Gathering Storm fixed to 30min raises AP; Manaflow is only useful on mana users.

Self starts at 10% HP, W champion once with enough missing HP; score W heal separately from rune/item healing. Log raw kit packet(s), post-mitigation damage and separate item/rune packets; repeat at 100% target HP and swap one item at a time. First Strike must be ready and champion initiates; compare eligible bonus separately.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

Highest-number candidate, not proof of mathematical maximum. Stored helper/statFormula or symbolic fields remain unresolved: validate live stat meanings/tick rules, do not silently infer. Unlimited game time changes Gathering Storm; no finite global maximum over unrestricted time. Damage cannot exceed remaining HP as an observed health loss; record theoretical packet separately. Crit does not automatically multiply spells/pets/procs.
tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Rabadon's Deathcap, Dawncore, Redemption, Mikael's Blessing, Ardent Censer, Spirit Visage. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Healing is capped by missing HP; self Visage does not amplify another ally heal.
Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.
